channel.title: The Virginia Gazette - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Virginia Gazette (vagazette.com)

item.title: Former ODU field hockey All-American, NCAA title-winning JMU coach retires for health reasons
item.description: Named the nation's top player with Old Dominion in 1984, Christy Morgan coached James Madison to 257 victories and five NCAA Tournaments, and the Dukes' NCAA title in '94 was their first in any sport.

item.title: Venezuela approves amnesty bill that could see release of hundreds detained for political reasons
item.description: Acting President Delcy Rodríguez is expected to sign the measure.

item.title: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson expanded to include South Carolina and Washington, DC
item.description: Jackson will lie in repose at the Chicago headquarters of his Rainbow PUSH Coalition.

item.title: NASA boss blasts Boeing and space agency managers for Starliner’s botched astronaut flight
item.description: Administrator Jared Isaacman said poor leadership and decision-making at Boeing led to Starliner's troubles.

item.title: Judge orders takeover of health care operations in Arizona prisons after years of poor care
item.description: The judge found Arizona violated prisoners’ rights by providing inadequate care.

item.title: Prosecutors stand by former Black Panther’s conviction but accuse judge of misconduct when he prosecuted the case
item.description: Al-Amin died in prison in November.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: York leaders want to keep no-wake zones from making waves among residents
item.description: The York County Board of Supervisors voted to create a temporary advisory committee to review all markers and recommend any needed changes.

item.title: High school scoreboard: Catholic, Steward reach TCIS girls basketball final
item.description: Also, the Grafton and Manor girls breeze to the Class 4 Region A basketball semifinals, and home teams enjoy a good night in the Metro Conference basketball quarterfinals

item.title: Camels sneak past William & Mary men at buzzer
item.description: Jeremiah Johnson's shot capped his 32-point night for Campbell, while Reese Miller scored 26 for the Tribe. Meanwhile, Hofstra handled Hampton in New York.
